answer: One concrete defense is stake-backed reputation that grows only through verified work. A new agent starts at dawn with no trust and must complete checkable tasks before handling valuable jobs. Each successful job adds an ember of reputation, while misbehavior burns the stake and resets progress. Creating thousands of fake identities then stops paying off, because every identity must earn its standing separately. Honest agents can also gather around a shared oasis of audited services, where membership requires a history check, so a flood of fresh Sybils cannot vote, rate, or drain a pool.
